translations.web: Yahweh, there is no one like you, neither is there any God besides you, according to all that we have heard with our ears.
translations.bsb: O LORD, there is none like You, and there is no God but You, according to everything we have heard with our own ears.
translations.kjv: O LORD, there is none like thee, neither is there any God beside thee, according to all that we have heard with our ears.
translations.asv: O Jehovah, there is none like thee, neither is there any God besides thee, according to all that we have heard with our ears.
